source.test: D-014, applied as a Phase 7 addition on top of each provider's raw listVersions() output

input.function: Phase 7 floor filter (new, layered on top of every provider's listVersions())

notes: None of the six providers filter by a version floor themselves (Vanilla/Purpur only filter by `release`/`"1."` prefix, for unrelated reasons); D-014's 1.20 cut is a Phase 7 addition layered uniformly on top of each provider's own raw list, applied to `GET /v1/versions/create` and `GET /v1/versions` only -- a below-floor server reached through raw or transfer import still lists, starts, and is fully manageable (D-014's own text: "not carried in provisioning logic", not "blocked"). The filter reuses the exact same numeric compareMCVersions comparator every provider already has (entry >= "1.20"), which is why the new YY.n-scheme versions ("26.2", "26.1.2") pass the floor and are kept even though they don't share Vanilla's own "1."-prefix release filter or Purpur's `hasPrefix("1.")` catalog filter -- major 26 numerically exceeds major 1, so no scheme-aware special case is needed here, the same way compareMCVersions already needed none for sorting.
